narrative_distance: close third on Mira, level 3-4; the interpreter's weighing of a word is the interiority
voice_principles: the discipline of rendering is the texture
a word is weighed before it is said; the weighing is the drama
no feeling is named that a choice of word could imply
diction: court register in session vs. bare dialect-plain in private
law words used sparingly, never as ornament
syntax: one long sentence reserved for the held breath before a rendering
rhythm: let the pause before a word do the work of description
imagery: breath, the microphone, the water jug, the two senses of one word
the valley only in glancing memory
dialogue: court speech is flat and procedural; the dialect is oblique, proverbial
avoid: legal-thriller theatrics (gavel, objection duels, a verdict scene)
Mira stating the theme (truth vs law)
